article_content: By Sarah Johnson, Chris Brooke, and Sam Webb. PUBLISHED: 15:10 EST, January 7, 2013 | UPDATED: 15:32 EST, January 10, 2013 The mild weather that ushered in 2013 will give way to freezing temperatures, sleet, and even snow, potentially lasting three weeks. Met Office forecasters predict temperatures could plummet to -15C in some northern regions next week as part of a cold snap expected to persist until early February. 'We anticipate a temperature decline over the next few days, with a chance of snow on higher ground in the north this Thursday,' stated Helen Chivers of the Met Office. 'From next week, temperatures will hover around 5C, with potential frost at night, possibly dropping to -5C in rural areas.' People enjoyed the mild weather, such as sightseers on the River Cam in Cambridge, but extreme cold, rain, and snow are approaching. A snowplow cleared snow near Nenthead, Cumbria, recently. More scenes like this are anticipated as the mild early January yields to harsh winter weather. The Met Office also indicated likely winter showers next week, and winds from the Northeast may trigger snow flurries. The mild weather at the start of January led to early blossom blooms, thanks to temperatures around 10C. Visitors in Cambridge also took advantage of the unusually high temperatures, punting on the River Cam. However, temperatures are expected to plunge below freezing this week, with clear skies and sunshine followed by widespread frost overnight into Thursday. Warm southerly winds and extensive cloud cover have resulted in above-average temperatures for this period. A Met Office spokesman commented: ‘We have consistently seen double-figure temperatures recently.’ ‘Average temperatures for this time of year are near freezing at night, but they have remained at 6 to 8C.’ The mild spell featured unseasonably high temperatures over the holiday period, reaching 14.3C (57F) in Wester Ross, Scotland, last Wednesday and 12.8C (55F) in Usk, Monmouthshire, on Thursday. Lucy Moir, 22, picks snowdrops that flowered early at Painswick Rococo Garden in Painswick, Gloucestershire. Visitors to Cambridge enjoyed the pink blossom on trees in the historic city. The warm weather has caused snowdrops to carpet a garden in Painswick, Gloucestershire. Paul Hervey-Brookes, garden advisor at Rococo, noted: 'They typically begin blooming around the second week of January and finish by the end of March.' 'But due to the mildness this year, they have been misled into thinking it is later in January, and they have started to emerge.' Visitors to Cambridge admired trees adorned with pink flowers in the historic city. Blossom typically appears in March, signaling spring, but visitors to Cambridge could enjoy the beautiful sight in early January. Rachel Clarke, 37, from Cambridge, commented: ‘It's delightful to see the blossom after weeks of wind and rain. Hopefully, it signals better weather this year.’ A winter red sky emerged as the sun rose over Bristol. Forecasters anticipate cold, frosty, and more wintry weather returning to the UK this week. Allotments are visible as the winter sun rises. Met Office forecaster Craig Snell stated: ‘Temperatures will trend colder, with more widespread frost, and it is likely to remain cold into next week with wintry showers, especially in central and eastern parts, with overnight frosts but also fine and dry weather.’ ‘Later next week, conditions are likely to remain colder than average, and from January 21 to February 4, there is an increasing probability of a trend towards colder conditions relative to what we've experienced so far this winter.’ ‘This brings the risk of spells of colder-than-average conditions and wintry weather, particularly across northern and eastern areas.’ Tom Tobler, a forecaster with MeteoGroup, said: 'It will be freezing in some areas this week but could get slightly colder if the skies are clearer than forecast.' 'This would be a return to more typical January temperatures compared to the milder weather we've been experiencing. There is the potential next week for some colder weather.' Mr. Snell added: ‘From next weekend, there is considerable uncertainty in the forecast. We’re on the boundary between colder and warmer air.' After a miserable 2012 – the second wettest on record – the prospect of a dry start to 2013 was welcome. However, the mild weather appears to have been a temporary deviation, with a return to cold, wet, grey days expected in the week ahead. The coming conditions will likely pale in comparison to the severe winter of 1963. In early 1963, the Thames froze, 6ft snowdrifts blocked London streets, and food prices soared.
translated_content: Autor: Sara Džonson, Kris Bruk i Sem Veb. OBJAVLJENO: 15:10 EST, 7. januar 2013. | AŽURIRANO: 15:32 EST, 10. januar 2013. Blago vreme koje je obeležilo početak 2013. godine ustupiće mesto temperaturama ispod nule, susnežici, pa čak i snegu, što bi moglo potrajati tri nedelje. Prognostičari Meteorološke službe predviđaju da bi temperature mogle pasti i do -15C u nekim severnim regionima sledeće nedelje, kao deo hladnog talasa koji se očekuje da potraje do početka februara. ‘Očekujemo pad temperature u narednih nekoliko dana, sa šansom za sneg na višim predelima na severu ovog četvrtka’, izjavila je Helen Čivers iz Meteorološke službe. ‘Od sledeće nedelje, temperature će se kretati oko 5C, sa potencijalnim mrazom noću, koji bi mogao pasti i do -5C u ruralnim područjima.’ Људи су уживали у благом времену, као што су туристи на реци Кем у Кембриџу, али се приближавају екстремна хладноћа, киша и снег. Чистач снега је недавно чистио снег у близини Нентхеда, Камбрија. Очекује се више оваквих призора јер благи рани јануар уступа место оштрој зимској сезони. Meteorološka služba je takođe ukazala na verovatne zimske pljuskove sledeće nedelje, a vetrovi sa severoistoka mogu izazvati snežne padavine. Blago vreme početkom januara довело је до раног цветања, захваљујући температурама око 10C. Posetioci Kembridža su takođe iskoristili neobično visoke temperature, vozeći se čamcima po reci Kem. Međutim, očekuje se da će temperature pasti испод нуле ове недеље, са ведрим небом и сунцем, након чега следи распрострањен мраз преко ноћи до четвртка. Topli južni vetrovi i велика облачност довели су до натпросечних температура за ово доба године. Portparol Meteorološke службе је прокоментарисао: ‘Nedavno смо доследно виђали двоцифрене температуре.’ ‘Просечне температуре за ово доба године су близу нуле ноћу, али су се задржале на 6 до 8C.’ Blagi period је имао необично високе температуре током празника, достижући 14,3C (57F) у Вестер Росу, Шкотска, прошле среде и 12,8C (55F) у Уску, Монмутшир, у четвртак. Луси Моир (22) бере висибабе које су рано процветале у Рококо врту Пејнсвик у Пејнсвику, Глостершир. Posetioci Kembridža su уживали у ружичастом цвету на дрвећу у историјском граду. Toplo vreme је довело до тога да су висибабе прекриле врт у Пејнсвику, Глостершир. Пол Херви-Брукс, саветник за врт у Рококоу, приметио је: ‘Обично почињу да цветају око друге недеље јануара и завршавају до краја марта.’ ‘Ali zbog blagosti ove godine, prevarene su da мисле да је касније у јануару, и почеле су да се појављују.’ Posetioci Kemбриџа су се дивили дрвећу украшеном ружичастим цвећем у историјском граду. Цветање се обично појављује у марту, сигнализирајући пролеће, али су posetioci Kemбриџа могли да уживају у прелепом призору почетком јануара. Рејчел Кларк (37) из Кембриџа је прокоментарисала: ‘Дивно је видети цвет након недеља ветра и кише. Надамо се да то сигнализира боље време ове године.’ Zimsko crveno nebo се појавило када је сунце изашло изнад Бристола. Prognostičari предвиђају да ће се хладно, мразно и зимско време вратити у Велику Британију ове недеље. Vrtovi su видљиви док зимско сунце излази. Prognozer Meteorološke службе, Kreg Snel, изјавио је: ‘Temperature ће постати хладније, са распрострањенијим мразом, и вероватно ће остати хладно до следеће недеље са зимским пљусковима, посебно у централним и источним деловима, са ноћним мразевима, али и лепим и сувим временом.’ ‘Kasnije sledeće недеље, услови ће вероватно остати хладнији од просека, а од 21. јануара до 4. фебруара постоји све већа вероватноћа тренда ка хладнијим условима у односу на оно што смо до сада искусили ове зиме.’ ‘Ovo donosi ризик од периода хладнијих услова од просека и зимског времена, посебно у северним и источним подручјима.’ Tom Tobler, prognostičar iz MeteoGroup, рекао је: ‘Biće смрзавања у неким областима ове недеље, али би могло бити мало хладније ако буде ведрије него што се предвиђа.’ ‘Ovo bi bio повратак на типичније јануарске температуре у поређењу са блажим временом које смо искусили. Postoji potencijal sledeće недеље за хладније време.’ Господин Снел је додао: ‘Од следећег викенда, постоји значајна неизвесност у прогнози. Налазимо се на граници између хладнијег и топлијег ваздуха.’ Након јадне 2012. године – друге највлажније забележене – изгледи за сув почетак 2013. године били су добродошли. Међутим, чини се да је благо време било привремено одступање, са повратком на хладне, мокре, сиве дане који се очекују у недељи која је пред нама. Предстојећи услови ће се вероватно умањити у поређењу са тешком зимом 1963. године. Почетком 1963. године, Темза се заледила, снежни наноси од 6 стопа блокирали су улице Лондона, а цене хране су порасле.

article_content: Terrifying footage has surfaced showing the moment a lightning bolt strikes a tree, splitting it in half and sending it crashing onto a busy road, just centimetres from a car's bonnet. The dash-cam footage, from Ryde in Sydney's north, shows panicking passengers gasping as sparks shoot from the tree, accompanied by a thundering boom. The video was taken during this week's storms, which battered Sydney for seven consecutive afternoons, bringing grey, dramatic skies, spectacular lightning, and ear-splitting thunder. The moment a lightning bolt strikes a tree near a freeway was captured on camera, showing sparks flying and a loud boom echoing in the air. Another driver, who narrowly avoided the falling tree, steps out in the torrential rain and flags down a passing ambulance. The vehicle closest to the fallen tree stops in the middle of the road, the driver seemingly in shock from the near miss. Another driver, who narrowly avoided the tree, exits her car in the torrential rain, inspects the vehicle, and speaks on her phone before flagging down a passing ambulance on the opposite side of the road. It is unknown if anyone was injured in the incident shown in the clip. The video, uploaded last Thursday and filmed in Ryde, northern Sydney, was taken during a week of spectacular storms in Sydney. Each evening saw humidity soar in the afternoon, followed by thunder and lightning before sundown. Photographer Roland Taylor layered multiple images of Wednesday's storm to capture the spectacular display of lightning. A dramatic storm moved across Sydney on Friday. The Bureau of Meteorology stated this week that the frequency and intensity of the recent weather events are rare. Firefighters contained a blaze in Pyrmont on Wednesday that broke out after a building was struck by lightning. The dramatic storms brought torrential rain, particularly to the western suburbs, where areas like Bankstown nearly doubled their average monthly rainfall from 67mm to 110mm. The State Emergency Service received over 1000 calls for assistance last week, including reports of flash flooding and fallen trees. The bureau has warned that the storms are expected to continue this week, with rain and thunderstorms forecast for the evenings.
translated_content: Zastrašujući snimak se pojavio, prikazujući trenutak kada grom udara u drvo, razdvajajući ga na pola i šaljući ga da padne na prometni put, samo nekoliko centimetara od haube automobila. Snimak sa kamere u automobilu, iz Rydea u severnom Sidneju, prikazuje panične putnike kako uzdišu dok varnice izbijaju iz drveta, praćene gromoglasnim udarom. Video je snimljen tokom ovonedeljnih oluja, koje su pogodile Sidnej sedam uzastopnih popodneva, donoseći siva, dramatična neba, spektakularne munje i zaglušujuću grmljavinu. Trenutak kada grom udara u drvo blizu autoputa zabeležen je kamerom, prikazujući varnice koje lete i glasan udar koji odjekuje u vazduhu. Drugi vozač, koji je za dlaku izbegao da ga udari drvo koje pada, izlazi na jaku kišu i zaustavlja vozilo hitne pomoći koje prolazi. Vozilo najbliže oborenom drvetu se zaustavlja nasred puta, vozač očigledno u šoku zbog bliskog susreta. Druga vozačica, koja je za dlaku izbegla drvo, izlazi iz svog automobila na jaku kišu, pregleda vozilo i razgovara na telefon pre nego što zaustavi vozilo hitne pomoći koje prolazi sa suprotne strane puta. Nepoznato je da li je neko povređen u incidentu prikazanom na snimku. Video, postavljen prošlog četvrtka i snimljen u Rydeu, severnom Sidneju, nastao je tokom nedelje spektakularnih oluja u Sidneju. Svako veče je vlažnost vazduha rasla popodne, nakon čega su usledili grmljavina i munje pre zalaska sunca. Fotograf Roland Tejlor je složio više slika oluje od srede kako bi zabeležio spektakularan prikaz munja. Dramatična oluja se kretala preko Sidneja u petak. Iz Biroa za meteorologiju su ove nedelje izjavili da su učestalost i intenzitet nedavnih vremenskih nepogoda retki. Vatrogasci su u sredu ugasili požar u Pirmontu koji je izbio nakon što je grom udario u zgradu. Dramatične oluje su donele obilne kiše, posebno u zapadnim predgrađima, gde su područja poput Bankstauna skoro udvostručila svoj prosečni mesečni nivo padavina sa 67 mm na 110 mm. Državna služba za hitne intervencije je primila preko 1000 poziva za pomoć prošle nedelje, uključujući izveštaje o poplavama i oborenom drveću. Iz biroa su upozorili da se oluje očekuju i ove nedelje, sa kišom i grmljavinom predviđenim za večernje sate.

article_content: French President Emmanuel Macron is touring Central Asia to bolster ties in a region where Russia and China wield considerable influence. Macron met with Kazakhstan’s President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev on Wednesday to discuss accelerating cooperation in crucial sectors. His next stop is Uzbekistan. During the meeting, France and Kazakhstan signed agreements spanning economic areas such as critical minerals for clean energy, pharmaceuticals, and aerospace. At a press conference in Astana, Macron emphasized the 'strength' of the partnership and the need to enhance it. Tokayev described France as a 'key and reliable partner' within the European Union, expressing his intention to further promote their relationship. France ranks as the fifth-largest foreign investor in Kazakhstan, with a longstanding relationship that includes the Kashagan offshore oilfield project (in partnership with TotalEnergies) and a uranium mine operated by Orano. The head of Orano is part of Macron’s delegation. Additionally, EDF is vying to construct Kazakhstan’s first nuclear power plant. Kazakhstan has distanced itself from the Kremlin in recent years, refusing to recognize breakaway states in Ukraine and adhering to Western sanctions against Moscow. The country is actively forging strategic partnerships with Western nations and supplying crude oil to European countries that have ceased purchasing Russian oil. With Russia preoccupied by the war in Ukraine, other global powers are intensifying efforts to establish strategic partnerships in the resource-rich Central Asian region. Russia has expressed concerns regarding Western ambitions in what it considers its 'back yard'. Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov stated last week that the West is attempting to pull Russia’s 'neighbors, friends, and allies' away. Alexander Shevtsov, a deputy of Russia’s Security Council, said in June that the United States and its allies are trying to support nationalist sentiment, spreading misinformation, and manipulating public opinion via the internet and social networks. Meanwhile, China has developed strong connections with Kazakhstan, investing significantly in infrastructure – particularly energy projects – and establishing the country as a vital link in its China-Europe trade route. Macron commended Astana for its refusal to side with Moscow on Ukraine, acknowledging the pressures it faces. Macron assured that they will progress on key international issues and uphold the United Nations charter and principles like territorial integrity and national sovereignty. He stated that this strategy aligns with France's view for a country that refuses to be a vassal and maintains balanced relations, which benefits its people. Following Kazakhstan, Macron will visit Uzbekistan, marking the first visit by a French leader since 1994. China is particularly active in Central Asia through its 'New Silk Road' project and its ambition to assume a leadership role in the region. Chinese President Xi Jinping presented a plan for Central Asian development at a G7 summit in May. Beijing intends to enhance bilateral investment agreements and increase cross-border freight volume, encouraging Chinese-funded businesses to create jobs, build warehouses, and initiate a special train service to promote tourism. Xi Jinping announced that China will provide Central Asian countries with 26 billion yuan [$3.5bn] in financing support and grants. Turkey has also demonstrated growing interest in the region, with Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan scheduled to visit Astana shortly after Macron.
translated_content: Francuski predsednik Emanuel Makron obilazi Centralnu Aziju kako bi ojačao veze u regionu gde Rusija i Kina imaju značajan uticaj. Makron se u sredu sastao sa predsednikom Kazahstana Kasim-Žomartom Tokajevim kako bi razgovarao o ubrzanju saradnje u ključnim sektorima. Njegova sledeća stanica je Uzbekistan. Tokom sastanka, Francuska i Kazahstan potpisali su sporazume koji obuhvataju ekonomske oblasti kao što su kritični minerali za čistu energiju, farmaceutika i vazduhoplovstvo. Na konferenciji za novinare u Astani, Makron je naglasio 'snagu' partnerstva i potrebu da se ono unapredi. Tokajev je opisao Francusku kao 'ključnog i pouzdanog partnera' u Evropskoj uniji, izražavajući nameru da dodatno unapredi njihovu saradnju. Francuska je peti najveći strani investitor u Kazahstanu, sa dugogodišnjim odnosom koji uključuje projekat naftnog polja Kašagan (u partnerstvu sa TotalEnergies) i rudnik uranijuma kojim upravlja Orano. Direktor kompanije Orano je deo Makronove delegacije. Pored toga, EDF konkuriše za izgradnju prve nuklearne elektrane u Kazahstanu. Kazahstan se poslednjih godina distancirao od Kremlja, odbijajući da prizna otcepljene države u Ukrajini i poštujući zapadne sankcije protiv Moskve. Zemlja aktivno gradi strateška partnerstva sa zapadnim zemljama i snabdeva sirovom naftom evropske zemlje koje su prestale da kupuju rusku naftu. Dok je Rusija zaokupljena ratom u Ukrajini, druge globalne sile pojačavaju napore da uspostave strateška partnerstva u Centralnoj Aziji, regionu bogatom resursima. Rusija je izrazila zabrinutost zbog zapadnih ambicija u onome što smatra svojim 'dvorištem'. Ministar spoljnih poslova Sergej Lavrov izjavio je prošle nedelje da Zapad pokušava da odvuče ruske 'susede, prijatelje i saveznike'. Aleksandar Ševcov, zamenik ruskog Saveta bezbednosti, izjavio je u junu da Sjedinjene Države i njihovi saveznici pokušavaju da podrže nacionalističko raspoloženje, šire dezinformacije i manipulišu javnim mnjenjem putem interneta i društvenih mreža. U međuvremenu, Kina je razvila snažne veze sa Kazahstanom, značajno ulažući u infrastrukturu – posebno u energetske projekte – i uspostavljajući zemlju kao vitalnu kariku u svom trgovinskom putu između Kine i Evrope. Makron je pohvalio Astanu zbog odbijanja da se svrsta na stranu Moskve u vezi sa Ukrajinom, priznajući pritisak sa kojim se suočava. Makron je uverio da će se napredovati po ključnim međunarodnim pitanjima i da će se poštovati Povelja Ujedinjenih nacija i principi kao što su teritorijalni integritet i nacionalni suverenitet. On je naveo da je ova strategija u skladu sa francuskim stavom, gde je zemlja nezavisna i održava uravnotežene odnose, što je u korist njenog naroda. Nakon Kazahstana, Makron će posetiti Uzbekistan, što predstavlja prvu posetu jednog francuskog lidera od 1994. godine. Kina je posebno aktivna u Centralnoj Aziji kroz svoj projekat 'Novi put svile' i ambiciju da preuzme vodeću ulogu u regionu. Kineski predsednik Si Đinping predstavio je plan za razvoj Centralne Azije na samitu Grupe sedam (G7) u maju. Si Đinping je najavio da će Kina obezbediti zemljama Centralne Azije finansijsku pomoć i bespovratna sredstva u iznosu od 26 milijardi juana (3,5 milijardi dolara). Turska je takođe pokazala rastuće interesovanje za region, a turski predsednik Redžep Tajip Erdogan bi trebalo da poseti Astanu ubrzo nakon Makrona.

article_content: In football history, it stands as one of the most infamous and controversial sending-off incidents, shaping the careers of those involved. In 1991, Nottingham Forest played West Ham in an FA Cup semi-final at Villa Park. West Ham, from a division below Forest, dominated the opening 20 minutes as clear underdogs. Then, a pivotal moment altered the match and the entire season, setting a precedent for refereeing and defending. A video features Gale and Hackett discussing the incident 23 years later. West Ham's Tony Gale was stunned when referee Keith Hackett penalized his professional foul on Nottingham Forest's Gary Crosby with a straight red card in the 1991 FA Cup semi-final. Gale brought Crosby down after 22 minutes as he broke clear on goal. Gale became the first player sent off for denying a clear goal-scoring opportunity, under rules altered just days before the match at Villa Park. As Forest's Gary Crosby advanced, Tony Gale of West Ham brought him down. To everyone's surprise, Keith Hackett issued a red card. Gale was the first footballer shown a straight red card for a professional foul denying a goal-scoring opportunity. While familiar now, Hackett's decision surprised many in 1991, and Gale remains unforgiving. Forest beat the 10-man West Ham 4-0, advancing to the final against Tottenham at Wembley. 23 years later, Gale still blames Hackett for ruining West Ham's Cup hopes. Hackett explains his decision to Gale, who reluctantly left the field. In a video for you-are-the-ref.com, Gale said: 'I still don't think I'd be sent off today, and I question the decision. I couldn't believe it was me in that situation.' 'It was the only blot on my copybook, making me infamous. It may have made Keith famous, but it was unforgivable for me.' Gale added that he believes Hackett wanted to make a name for himself: 'I thought it was egotistical; Keith wanted to be the first to make that decision.' Gale (left) reunited with Hackett (right), with You Are the Ref presenter Alan Biggs present. Roy Keane scored Forest's second goal as Steve Potts tried to intervene. Stuart Pearce broke through the West Ham defense to make it three-up for Forest at Villa Park. Forest's Mark Crossley, Steve Chettle, and Tommy Gaynor celebrated their advancement to the final. The defender, with 300 league appearances for West Ham from 1984 to 1994, believes his suspension cost West Ham the second division championship. Hackett insists Gale was a victim of new rules introduced by the Football Association days before the match. He said: 'Ken Ridden at the FA called all referees to discuss this type of incident. Managers and referees below Football League level were unaware of this interpretation.' 'If this happened a week earlier, Tony wouldn't have received a yellow card.' Highlights of the match after Gale's sending off are available in a video. Gale in action for West Ham against Gary Lineker of Tottenham the following season. 'It ruined the game for spectators, and I was unhappy with the decision. I threw my bag into the car, and an FA guy said, "Well done. If you hadn't sent him off, you'd have been suspended."' 'I remembered that and had some choice words for him. I later received death threats, which were taken seriously.' Hackett still opposes the rule, despite its establishment in the game. Tottenham beat Nottingham Forest in the final at Wembley, 2-1. Forest manager Brian Clough led his team out at Wembley. 'I still think denying an obvious goal-scoring opportunity is a bad law. Inside the penalty area, the denial is replaced by a penalty kick.' 'It's a triple jeopardy: dismissal, penalty, and suspension, which isn't right.' Brian Clough's Forest lost 2-1 to Terry Venables' Spurs in the final, but the controversy of Gale's red card continues. You can see the full exchange between Tony Gale and Keith Hackett at you-are-the-ref.com.
translated_content: U fudbalskoj istoriji, ovo ostaje jedan od najozloglašenijih i najkontroverznijih incidenata isključenja, koji je oblikovao karijere onih koji su bili uključeni. Godine 1991, Notingem Forest je igrao protiv Vest Hema u polufinalu FA kupa na Vila Parku. Vest Hem, iz divizije ispod Foresta, dominirao je u prvih 20 minuta kao jasan autsajder. Tada je ključni trenutak izmenio tok utakmice i celu sezonu, postavljajući presedan za suđenje i odbranu. Video prikazuje Gejla i Haketa kako razgovaraju o incidentu 23 godine kasnije. Toni Gejl iz Vest Hema bio je zapanjen kada je sudija Kit Haket kaznio njegov profesionalni faul nad Garijem Krosbijem iz Notingem Foresta direktnim crvenim kartonom u polufinalu FA kupa 1991. Gejl je oborio Krosbija nakon 22 minuta dok je ovaj bio u prodoru ka golu. Gejl je postao prvi igrač koji je isključen zbog uskraćivanja očigledne prilike za postizanje gola, po pravilima koja su izmenjena samo nekoliko dana pre utakmice na Vila Parku. Dok je Gari Krosbi iz Foresta napredovao, Toni Gejl iz Vest Hema ga je oborio. Na svačije iznenađenje, Kit Haket je pokazao crveni karton. Gejl je bio prvi fudbaler kome je pokazan direktan crveni karton zbog profesionalnog faula kojim je uskraćena očigledna prilika za postizanje gola. Iako je to sada uobičajeno, Haketova odluka je iznenadila mnoge 1991. godine, a Gejl ostaje nepopustljiv. Forest je pobedio Vest Hem sa 10 igrača rezultatom 4-0, plasirajući se u finale protiv Totenhema na Vembliju. 23 godine kasnije, Gejl i dalje krivi Haketa što je uništio snove Vest Hema o Kupu. Haket objašnjava svoju odluku Gejlu, koji je nevoljno napustio teren. U video snimku za you-are-the-ref.com, Gejl je rekao: 'I dalje ne mislim da bih bio isključen danas, i preispitujem tu odluku. Nisam mogao da verujem da sam se ja našao u toj situaciji.' 'To je bila jedina mrlja u mojoj karijeri, zbog koje sam postao ozloglašen. Možda je to učinilo Kita poznatim, ali meni je bilo neoprostivo.' Gejl je dodao da veruje da je Haket želeo da se proslavi: 'Mislio sam da je to bio egoističan potez; Kit je želeo da bude prvi koji će doneti takvu odluku.' Gejl (levo) se ponovo sastao sa Haketom (desno), uz prisustvo voditelja emisije You Are the Ref, Alana Bigsa. Roj Kin je postigao drugi gol za Forest dok je Stiv Pots pokušavao da ga zaustavi. Stjuart Pirs je probio odbranu Vest Hema i postigao treći gol za Forest na Vila Parku. Mark Krosli, Stiv Četl i Tomi Gejnor iz Foresta proslavili su plasman u finale. Defanzivac, koji je odigrao 300 ligaških utakmica za Vest Hem od 1984. do 1994. godine, veruje da je njegova suspenzija koštala Vest Hem titule u drugoj ligi. Haket insistira da je Gejl bio žrtva novih pravila koje je uvela Fudbalska asocijacija nekoliko dana pre utakmice. On je rekao: 'Ken Riden iz FA je pozvao sve sudije da razgovaraju o ovoj vrsti incidenta. Menadžeri i sudije ispod nivoa Fudbalske lige u to vreme nisu bili svesni ove interpretacije.' 'Da se ovo dogodilo nedelju dana ranije, Toni ne bi dobio ni žuti karton.' Snimak najzanimljivijih detalja utakmice nakon Gejlovog isključenja dostupan je u video snimku. Gejl u akciji za Vest Hem protiv Garija Linekera iz Totenhema sledeće sezone. 'To je uništilo utakmicu za gledaoce, a ja sam bio nezadovoljan odlukom. Bacio sam torbu u auto, a čovek iz FA je rekao: "Bravo. Da ga nisi isključio, ti bi bio suspendovan."' 'Zapamtio sam to i imao sam neke izabrane reči za njega. Kasnije sam dobijao pretnje smrću, koje su shvaćene ozbiljno.' Haket se i dalje protivi tom pravilu, uprkos njegovom uspostavljanju u igri. Totenhem je pobedio Notingem Forest u finalu na Vembliju rezultatom 2-1. Menadžer Foresta, Brajan Klaf, poveo je svoj tim na Vembli. 'I dalje mislim da je uskraćivanje očigledne prilike za postizanje gola loš zakon. Unutar kaznenog prostora, uskraćivanje se zamenjuje penalom.' 'To je trostruka kazna: isključenje, penal i suspenzija, što nije u redu.' Forest Brajana Klafa izgubio je sa 2-1 od Sparsa Terija Vejblsa u finalu, ali se kontroverza oko Gejlovog crvenog kartona nastavlja. article_content: In Sao Paulo, Uruguay and England, both desperate for a win, clashed in a highly anticipated World Cup match, a key event for ITV's primetime schedule, potentially the most-watched broadcast of the year. Adrian Chiles hosted the ITV broadcast from Rio, joined by Lee Dixon, former England coach Glenn Hoddle, and Gus Poyet. Ian Wright was notably absent, having returned to the UK following a distressing home break-in. Andros Townsend made a visible contribution pitchside for ITV, even as England suffered a 2-1 defeat to Uruguay. ITV strategically placed Andros Townsend at the Arena Corinthians. The commentary team featured two Townsends: Andros, who unexpectedly rose to prominence in England's journey to Brazil but saw his own World Cup hopes dashed by injury, and Andy Townsend, serving as co-commentator alongside the seasoned Clive Tyldesley. Andy Townsend's performance was under increased scrutiny, especially after Phil Neville's challenging debut on the BBC. In contrast, Neville’s BBC colleagues, Danny Murphy and Martin Keown, delivered confident and well-informed co-commentary. Martin O’Neill's addition to ITV’s World Cup team was well-received, bringing his characteristic insightful and sometimes conflicting viewpoints. He engaged in lively debate with Patrick Vieira before joining the universal praise for Tim Cahill’s spectacular goal for Australia. Rio Ferdinand and Neil Lennon also shared their excitement at being ‘privileged’ to experience the atmosphere inside the legendary Maracana. The carefully selected crowd shots added a vibrant and festive element to the TV experience, offering compelling viewing from Sao Paulo. ITV's broadcast began with the widely anticipated news of Suarez's inclusion in the Uruguay team, despite concerns about his fitness. This dominated the experts' initial discussions. Andros Townsend suggested even a less-than-fully-fit Suarez posed a significant threat. Chiles aptly described the match as ‘knock-out football’. The broadcast featured poignant moments where England players directly addressed the camera, expressing their feelings about representing their country. Tyldesley and Andy Townsend set the scene effectively, noting the challenging history of watching England in the World Cup. England initiated the match strongly, with a Rooney free-kick threatening the Uruguay goal, countered by a shot from Rodriguez. Tyldesley remarked on England's positive momentum, nearly rewarded by a Rooney goal. However, in the 39th minute, Suarez scored a remarkable header, highlighting his scoring ability regardless of fitness. His second goal secured Uruguay’s victory, solidifying his impact on the game. Rooney's earlier equalizer provided a moment of hope amidst the eventual defeat, while a late error from Steven Gerrard contributed to Suarez's decisive goal.

Ušao je u živu raspravu sa Patrickom Vieirom pre nego što se pridružio opštem hvaljenju spektakularnog gola Tima Cahilla za Australiju. Rio Ferdinand i Neil Lennon su takođe podelili svoje uzbuđenje što su 'imali privilegiju' da dožive atmosferu unutar legendarne Marakane. Andros Townsend je sugerisao da čak i Suarez koji nije potpuno spreman predstavlja značajnu pretnju. Chiles je prikladno opisao meč kao 'nokaut fazu'. Prenos je sadržao dirljive trenutke u kojima su se igrači Engleske direktno obratili kameri, izražavajući svoja osećanja u vezi sa predstavljanjem svoje zemlje. Tyldesley i Andy Townsend su efikasno postavili scenu, naglašavajući izazovnu istoriju gledanja Engleske na Svetskom prvenstvu. Engleska je snažno započela meč, a slobodan udarac Rooneya je ugrozio gol Urugvaja, na šta je uzvraćeno udarcem Rodrigueza. Tyldesley je primetio pozitivan zamah Engleske, koji je umalo krunisan Rooneyevim golom. Međutim, u 39. minutu, Suarez je postigao izvanredan gol glavom, naglašavajući svoju sposobnost postizanja golova bez obzira na fizičku spremnost. Njegov drugi gol je osigurao pobedu Urugvaja, učvršćujući njegov uticaj na utakmicu. Rooneyev raniji gol za izjednačenje je pružio trenutak nade usred eventualnog poraza, dok je kasna greška Stevena Gerrarda doprinela Suarezovom odlučujućem golu.

article_content: Michael Jackson's impact on popular culture remains significant. Perhaps his most notable legacy is his transformation of the music industry. Jackson's influence is still felt today. According to Howard Bragman, a PR expert who collaborated with Jackson on a shoe line with L.A. Gear, 'He changed history as a performer with his singing, songwriting, choreography, dancing, and business sense.' Bragman added that Jackson redefined the entertainment industry. Jackson transcended racial boundaries and bridged musical genres. He built upon the foundations laid by Elvis and the Beatles to establish an international fan base, anticipating globalization. He also became a savvy negotiator, elevating artists from performers to influential figures in the boardroom. James Walker, an entertainment attorney, noted, 'His initial 30 years set the stage for other artists, a detail sometimes overshadowed by later legal issues.' Walker emphasized, 'Michael surpassed racial barriers before Michael Jordan, Oprah, Tiger Woods, and Barack Obama. His impact on black artists and the music industry as a whole cannot be understated.' His 1982 album, 'Thriller,' sold over 50 million copies worldwide, a benchmark unlikely to be surpassed given current market trends. Gideon Yago from IFC Media Project commented that 'Records don't sell like they used to because the industry has changed due to technology.' The music videos accompanying 'Thriller' became industry benchmarks as MTV and cable television expanded, providing outlets for marketing. Jackson's label had to lobby MTV, which initially favored rock artists, to feature his videos. Walker recalled Walter Yetnikoff insisting that MTV play Jackson's videos or risk losing all CBS videos. Tommy Mottola, Yetnikoff's successor, said Jackson's innovative videos defined the video age. Despite late-life financial difficulties, Jackson made strategic business moves, notably acquiring half of the Beatles' music catalog in 1985 for $47.5 million. Walker estimates the catalog's value between $500 million and $1 billion. While his estate's current value is unclear, debts were around $500 million earlier this month, according to the Wall Street Journal. As live events became more vital due to declining album sales, Tom Barrack from Colony Capital and Philip Anschutz from AEG Live planned Jackson's comeback with London concerts. A sold-out 50-date residency at AEG Live's O2 arena was scheduled. Future plans included a world tour, Broadway musical, and 'Thriller' casino. Barrack told The Los Angeles Times that Jackson could earn $500 million annually. Billboard estimated $85 million in ticket sales. AEG Live declined to comment. Lucy Ellison from O2 stadium stated that ticketing refunds would be processed, with further announcements deferred to Jackson's family. Jackson was expected to earn $50 million from the London shows. CNN's Pauline Chiou contributed to this report.
translated_content: Uticaj Majkla Džeksona na popularnu kulturu ostaje značajan. Možda je njegovo najznačajnije nasleđe transformacija muzičke industrije. Džeksonov uticaj se i dalje oseća. Prema Hauardu Bragmanu, stručnjaku za odnose sa javnošću koji je sarađivao sa Džeksonom na liniji obuće sa L.A. Gear-om, 'On je promenio istoriju kao izvođač svojim pevanjem, pisanjem pesama, koreografijom, plesom i poslovnim smislom.' Bragman je dodao da je Džekson redefinisao industriju zabave. Džekson je prevazišao rasne granice i premostio muzičke žanrove. Nadogradio je temelje koje su postavili Elvis i Bitlsi kako bi uspostavio međunarodnu bazu obožavalaca, nagoveštavajući globalizaciju. Takođe je postao pronicljiv pregovarač, uzdižući umetnike od izvođača do uticajnih figura u upravnim odborima. Džejms Voker, advokat za zabavu, primetio je: 'Njegovih prvih 30 godina postavilo je scenu za druge umetnike, detalj koji ponekad zasene kasniji pravni problemi.' Voker je naglasio: 'Majkl je nadmašio rasne barijere pre Majkla Džordana, Opra Vinfri, Tajgera Vudsa i Baraka Obame. Njegov uticaj na crne umetnike i muzičku industriju u celini ne može se potceniti.' Njegov album iz 1982. godine, 'Thriller', prodat je u preko 50 miliona primeraka širom sveta, što je rekord koji je malo verovatno da će biti nadmašen s obzirom na trenutne trendove na tržištu. Gideon Jago iz IFC Media Project-a je prokomentarisao da 'Ploče se više ne prodaju kao nekada jer se industrija promenila zbog tehnologije.' Muzički spotovi koji su pratili album 'Thriller' postali su industrijski standardi sa širenjem MTV-a i kablovske televizije, pružajući kanale za marketing. Džeksonova izdavačka kuća morala je da lobira kod MTV-a, koji je u početku favorizovao rok izvođače, da prikaže njegove spotove. Voker se prisetio da je Volter Jetnikof insistirao da MTV pušta Džeksonove spotove ili rizikuje da izgubi sve spotove CBS-a. Tomi Motola, Jetnikofov naslednik, rekao je da su Džeksonovi inovativni spotovi definisali video eru. Uprkos finansijskim poteškoćama u kasnijem životu, Džekson je napravio strateške poslovne poteze, posebno kupovinom polovine muzičkog kataloga Bitlsa 1985. godine za 47,5 miliona dolara. Voker procenjuje vrednost kataloga na između 500 miliona i 1 milijarde dolara. Iako je trenutna vrednost njegove imovine nejasna, dugovi su iznosili oko 500 miliona dolara ranije ovog meseca, prema pisanju Wall Street Journal-a. Kako su događaji uživo postali važniji zbog opadanja prodaje albuma, Tom Barak iz Colony Capital-a i Filip Anšuc iz AEG Live-a planirali su Džeksonov povratak koncertima u Londonu. Rasprodata serija od 50 koncerata u O2 areni u produkciji AEG Live-a bila je zakazana. Budući planovi su uključivali svetsku turneju, brodvejski mjuzikl i kazino sa temom 'Thriller'. Barak je rekao za Los Angeles Times da bi Džekson mogao da zaradi 500 miliona dolara godišnje. Billboard je procenio prihod od 85 miliona dolara od prodaje karata. AEG Live je odbio da komentariše. Lusi Elison iz O2 stadiona izjavila je da će proces povraćaja novca za karte biti organizovan, a dalja obaveštenja biće prepuštena Džeksonovoj porodici. Očekivalo se da će Džekson zaraditi 50 miliona dolara od nastupa u Londonu. Paulina Čiou sa CNN-a doprinela je ovom izveštaju.

According to the lawsuit, she had a sexual health check-up in December 2010 with clear results but tested positive for genital herpes in February 2012. She's suing for sexual battery, intentional infliction of emotional distress, fraud, and negligence. Adrienne seeks unspecified damages, but Thomas will contest the claims in court. Thomas's attorneys claim the woman is angry, mean, and vindictive, alleging a ploy for compensation. One of his lawyers, Adam Kenner, stated that the allegations are a ploy for compensation. Thomas and his current girlfriend have a child together, the lawyer said. Thomas will be tested for herpes as part of the case. He has not directly commented on the lawsuit.

article_content: Bolivian authorities have confiscated a large quantity of cocaine hidden within hundreds of wine bottles, state media reported Thursday. The diluted and solid cocaine is valued at approximately $2 million, and officials suspect it's connected to a drug smuggling operation destined for Italy, according to the ABI news agency. During a raid in Santa Cruz, police apprehended a Brazilian national who reportedly attempted suicide with a knife when officers approached, ABI stated. Marco Centellas, head of Bolivia's anti-narcotics special forces, told the state news agency: 'They were diluting the cocaine and packaging it in bottles, ready to apply wine labels.'

Procenjena vrednost razređenog i čvrstog kokaina iznosi oko 2 miliona dolara, a zvaničnici sumnjaju da je povezan sa krijumčarenjem droge namenjenom Italiji, prema agenciji ABI. Tokom racije u Santa Kruzu, policija je uhapsila državljanina Brazila koji je, prema navodima agencije ABI, pokušao da se ubije nožem kada su mu prišli policajci. Marko Centeljas, šef bolivijskih specijalnih snaga za borbu protiv narkotika, izjavio je za državnu novinsku agenciju: 'Razređivali su kokain i pakovali ga u flaše, spremni da zalepe etikete vina.'
